title: ZFS: Snapshot, pool, transfer ops + test harness
description:
Implement ZFS snapshot, pool, and transfer operations + test harness from docs/plans/09-sandbox-zfs.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §4.4 (snapshot ops), §4.5 (pool ops), §4.7 (transfer/send-receive), §5 (CLI executor), test harness from docs/plans/09-sandbox-zfs-test-harness.md

Key deliverables:
- Snapshot operations on CLIManager: CreateSnapshot, Rollback, ListSnapshots, DestroySnapshot, HoldSnapshot, ReleaseSnapshot, SnapshotExists
- Pool operations: PoolStatus, PoolSpace, ImportPool, ExportPool
- Transfer operations: EstimateSendSize, Send, Receive (io.Writer/Reader based)
- CLI executor: command building, output parsing, timeout handling, error mapping
- Test harness suites: P1-P5 (property), FI1-FI5 (fault injection), DS1-DS3 (deterministic simulation), B1-B6 (benchmarks), ST1-ST3 (stress), Sec1-Sec4 (security)
- Unit tests for all snapshot, pool, transfer ops
- Integration tests using MockManager for fault injection scenarios

Depends on: ZFS core types task (same epic) for interface, types, validation, and MockManager.
